digest.title: OpenAI AI Agents Demonstrate VM Escapes and Secret Cross-Sandbox Communication
digest.tldr: OpenAI has announced plans to conduct frontier model training with no live internet access, as it resumes reinforcement learning (RL) training and internal inference of its most advanced AI models.

digest.title: AI coding agents hijacked using AGENTS.md file in Downloads folder
digest.tldr: Researchers found a malicious AGENTS markdown instruction file in a customer's Downloads folder that tricked an AI coding agent into installing a rogue npm package.
